articles.summary: Gross written premiums up 32% and combined ratio of 88.9% in first quarter as a public company Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings (NYSE: ASIC) today announced financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2025. The Company reported net income attributable to stockholders of $17.6 million, or $0.39 per diluted share, compared to $4.9 million, or $0.14 per diluted share, in the prior-year period. Adjusted net income attributable to stockholders (1) was $17.9 million, or $0.41 per dil
articles.title: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings Reports Second Quarter 2025 Results
